name: io.github.tonyyang0504/magalu-mcp
description: Magalu Marketplace (ecommerce channels): me, set_inventory, end_listing, list_orders. Every tool map

environmentVariables.name: PLATFORM_MCP_MAGALU_CLIENT_ID
environmentVariables.description: Client ID of your application created with the ID Magalu CLI (see developers.magalu.com > Primeiros passos > Criar aplicação).

environmentVariables.name: PLATFORM_MCP_MAGALU_CLIENT_SECRET
environmentVariables.description: Client secret of the same application.

environmentVariables.name: PLATFORM_MCP_MAGALU_REFRESH_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: Refresh token from a one-time authorization-code consent of the seller at https://id.magalu.com (scopes such as open:portfolio:read/write, open:order-order:read). If ID Magalu returns a new refresh token on refresh, the runtime keeps it (and saves it with PLATFORM_MCP_STATE_DIR).

environmentVariables.name: PLATFORM_MCP_MAGALU_CHANNEL_ID
environmentVariables.description: Sales channel id the stock applies to (GET /seller/v1/portfolios/me returns channel.id).
